info.title: airskills HTTP API
info.description:
**Unstable — pre-v1. Shapes will change.**

This is the HTTP protocol the airskills CLI speaks to airskills.ai. The CLI
is open source ([github.com/chrismdp/airskills](https://github.com/chrismdp/airskills))
and nothing stops you from pointing it at your own server — the endpoints
below are the full contract you need to implement.

## No lock-in

airskills.ai is the reference implementation of this protocol, not the only
one. If you want to run your own server (for compliance, for fun, because
you already have a filesystem-backed skill store you'd rather keep), the
contract is right here. Until v1 lands you'll need to keep your implementation
in step with whatever breaks, but the surface is small.

## Auth

Most endpoints require a bearer token obtained via the `airskills login`
flow or a direct Supabase Auth exchange. The CLI stores refresh tokens in
`~/.config/airskills/`.

Public endpoints (no auth) are tagged `public`. Auth-optional endpoints
declare `security: [{ bearerAuth: [] }, {}]` — anonymous callers get
the public-visibility subset, authenticated callers see what RLS allows.

## Content hashing

Push uses a Merkle-style content hash computed over the skill's file set.
The client sends its expected hash in `X-Expected-Hash` (or its preferred
`X-Expected-Commit`) on archive PUT so the server can detect concurrent
writes. Both sides must use the same algorithm (sorted by path in byte order,
`path:sha256hex` lines joined with `\n`, then SHA-256 over the manifest).
See `cmd/hash.go:computeMerkleHash` in the CLI repo for the reference
implementation.

## Generation

This document is generated from the Zod schemas the route handlers
themselves use to validate input. A drift guard in CI walks
`app/api/v1/` and asserts every `(method, path)` pair appears in the
spec — adding a route without a corresponding registry entry breaks
the build.

tags.name: suggestions
tags.description: Propose changes back to a skill owner.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase-issued JWT. Obtained via `airskills login` or /api/v1/auth/refresh.

role.description: Global role. Distinct from per-org membership role. CHECK constraint on profiles.role pins the values.

cli_logged_in_at.description: First time the user generated a CLI session token. Write-once.

mcp_connected_at.description: First time the user made an authenticated MCP request. Write-once.

owner_id.description: null on org-owned skills (XOR with org_id).

version.description: Semver-ish label — not authoritative; use content_hash.

content_hash.description: Merkle hash of the skill's file set. null until first push.

upstream_content_hash.description: Live content_hash of the parent skill (forks only). null when no parent or unreadable.

deleted_at.description: Soft-delete timestamp. null on live skills; set on the deleted-skills view.

deletion_reason.description: Why the skill was soft-deleted (e.g. 'user_deleted', 'transferred'). null on live skills.

skillset.description: Present when the caller uses effective skillset mode (no scope parameter).

owner.description: Joined from profiles. null on org-owned skills.

org.description: Joined from orgs. null on personally-owned skills.

private_dependencies.description: Returned when changing visibility to public WITHOUT make_deps_public:true and private dependencies exist. The skill is still updated; the caller decides whether to make them public.

warning.description: Soft-limit warnings, e.g. storage usage above 80%.

OwnerNamespace.description: Resolved namespace at write time. CLI uses this to detect out-of-band transfers. Key absent when owner is unchanged.

owner_id.description: null when the target is an org-owned skill (XOR with owner_org_id).

owner_org_id.description: set when the target is an org-owned skill; the org whose owners/admins review it.

since.description: Echo of the `since` query parameter (ISO timestamp).

skillset.description: Hard-coded `{slug:'default', name:'default'}` post-migration 047. Preserved as an envelope so older CLI binaries that read it don't crash.

source.description: Which side the skill comes from in the caller's effective set (migration 047).

org_slug.description: Owning org slug when source='org'; null for user-owned.

shadowed.description: True when an org skill with the same slug is winning the partition; the CLI should skip writing this skill to disk and surface a warning.

shadowed_reason.description: Why this row is shadowed; null when shadowed=false.

allOf.description: Resolved namespace; differs from the URL slug if the skill was transferred. `null` when no owner is resolvable.

bundle_skills.description: Joined skill rows; deprecated — bundles are being phased out for skillsets.

slug.description: Destination owner username or org slug.

moved_to.description: Present only when the caller has RLS access to the transferred destination.

skill_count.description: Number of skills currently in the skillset.

allOf.description: Caller's resolved active skillset (default if any, else first owned).

org_assigned.description: Skillsets the caller has been assigned via org membership.

skills.description: Resolved skill rows currently in the skillset (minimal projection).

member_count.description: Member count of the resolved org. Omitted on the {org: null} short-circuit (no membership / not found).

pricing_notice.description: Set when org has hit the free-tier member limit; null otherwise.

get.description: Public liveness probe. Reports the platform's version, commit, and the latest released CLI tag.

patch.description: Allowlisted fields: username, display_name. Username must match `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$` (min 2 chars) and must not be a reserved word. Handler currently does ad-hoc validation — UpdateMeSchema documents the wire shape.

400.description: Username invalid or reserved, or DB error.

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a fresh access token. The CLI calls this transparently when it sees a 401.

400.description: refresh_token missing or malformed

post.description: Creates an empty skill record. Use PUT /skills/{id}/archive to upload the file set.

400.description: Validation failed

403.description: Creating an org-owned skill requires admin or owner role on that org.

409.description: Slug already exists in caller's effective skill set (their own or inherited from an assigned org skillset).

500.description: Storage hash mismatch or commit RPC failure.

get.description: Returns skills the caller can see. Use scope for ownership queries, or skillset/no scope for the caller's effective sync surface.

schema.description: `personal` filters to caller-owned skills; `org` to skills in any of the caller's orgs. Default: all accessible.

parameters.description: `personal` filters to caller-owned skills; `org` to skills in any of the caller's orgs. Default: all accessible.
parameters.name: scope

schema.description: Filter to the effective skill set for this personal skillset slug. Must not be combined with scope.

parameters.description: Filter to the effective skill set for this personal skillset slug. Must not be combined with scope.

parameters.name: deleted

400.description: Invalid query combination or database error.

404.description: Requested skillset not found

get.description: Auth-optional. With a Bearer token RLS surfaces owned, org-member, and shared skills; without one, only public skills are visible. Response includes the skill's file listing and resolved dependencies.

200.description: Skill detail (with files, dependencies, joined owner/org)

404.description: Not found

put.description: Metadata only. The handler does ad-hoc allowlist validation (name, description, visibility, plus the operational toggles pull_upstream/confirm_public/make_deps_public); the Zod schema below documents the wire shape but is not yet enforced at runtime — see the comment on UpdateSkillSchema in lib/schemas.ts. Renames record a slug redirect so old links keep working. Setting visibility to 'public' requires confirm_public: true; if private dependencies exist they appear in the 200 response unless make_deps_public: true is also set.

pull_upstream.description: If true, advance this fork's pin to the parent's latest version. All other fields ignored.

confirm_public.description: Required when changing visibility to 'public'. The server returns 400 without it.

make_deps_public.description: When making a skill public, also publicise any private dependencies in one atomic update.

400.description: Validation failed, no fields to update, missing confirm_public on a public flip, or upstream not present for pull_upstream.

409.description: Slug collision after rename — either same namespace, or a cross-namespace shadow from the caller's effective set.

delete.description: Soft-deletes the skill. Restorable via POST /skills/{id}/restore until cleanup.

400.description: Database error

404.description: Not found

put.description: Uploads a tar.gz of the skill's file set. Conflict detection prefers X-Expected-Commit, falls back to X-Expected-Hash. On 409 the CLI pulls the remote so the user's agent can read both versions and merge — no auto-merge.

schema.description: Commit ID the client believes is HEAD. Preferred over X-Expected-Hash.

parameters.description: Commit ID the client believes is HEAD. Preferred over X-Expected-Hash.
parameters.name: X-Expected-Commit

schema.description: Merkle content hash fallback when the client doesn't track commit IDs. The server skips this check when the skill has never been pushed (content_hash is null).

parameters.description: Merkle content hash fallback when the client doesn't track commit IDs. The server skips this check when the skill has never been pushed (content_hash is null).
parameters.name: X-Expected-Hash

schema.description: Client-computed Merkle hash of the upload. Server cross-checks.

parameters.description: Client-computed Merkle hash of the upload. Server cross-checks.
parameters.name: X-Content-Hash

400.description: Empty archive, hash mismatch, or SKILL.md name/slug mismatch.

404.description: Skill not found

get.description: Returns the commit DAG ordered newest-first. Each commit links to its parents. RLS scopes the result; a non-existent or unreachable skill returns an empty array, not 404.

400.description: Database error

post.description: Restores files from the target commit and creates a merge commit (current HEAD + target as parents). Returns the bare commit-result; archive PUT's `current_owner`/`warning`/`unresolved_dependencies` extras are NOT added on rollback.

200.description: New HEAD commit created from the target.

400.description: Validation failed or commit has no archived files.

404.description: Commit not found

post.description: Proposes a change to a skill the caller doesn't own, based on their forked copy. The caller must own the suggester skill. For a PERSONAL target the skill must be public (drive-by disclosure protection). For an ORG-owned target the caller must be a plain member of the org — owners/admins have write access and push directly, so they cannot suggest.

The first segment can be a username OR an org slug — the response's `current_owner` is the canonical namespace at resolve time. The `bundle` variant is kept for backwards compatibility; bundles are deprecated in favour of skillsets.

post.summary: Transfer ownership between user and org
post.description: Soft-deletes the source skill and creates a new skill row at the target with a new skill_id. The new skill inherits the commit DAG (parent_ids remapped) and gets a fresh HEAD commit recording the SKILL.md name rewrite. Old skill_id returns 410 on subsequent reads. Permissions: user→org requires caller is current owner AND admin/owner of target org; org→user requires caller is org owner AND target is themselves.

404.description: Skill or target org not found.

409.description: Slug already exists in the target namespace — pass slug to rename.

500.description: RPC failure during the transfer transaction or storage hash mismatch.
